name: bdm
description: Bentley Development Management — shared Claude skills for contract administration and BDM document standards.

plugins.name: bdm-standards
plugins.description: BDM house style and brand rules (Brand Standard R3 — Calibri), document QA, self-contained PDF export and Datum markup. Install this one first; everything else assumes it.

plugins.name: bdm-contract-admin
plugins.description: Contract administration under AS4000 — variations and CSAs, EOTs, the Contract Admin Register, progress certificates, tender clarifications and addenda, site inspections and meeting minutes.
